name: rosetta-munchausen-numbers
code:
use default

power(value: int, exponent: int) -> int =>
    if exponent == 0 then
        1
    else
        value * power(value, exponent - 1)
    fi

digit_powers(number: int) -> int =>
    "{number}"
        |> map((character: char) =>
            cast int(character) - cast int('0'))
        |> filter(digit => digit > 0)
        |> reduce(0, (total, digit) => total + power(digit, digit))

let munchausen = (1::5000)
    |> filter(number => digit_powers(number) == number)
    |> map(number => "{number}")
    |> join(" ")

write_line("Munchausen numbers up to 5000: {munchausen}")
